lines.text: Frost in the furrows again. Ground ought to be warming by now.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.text: You can count the seed twice. It will not make a second harvest.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.text: Mind the rows, friend. There is still something living here.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.text: Bridge is open. Now let us see if the seed gets through.
lines.direction: plain, weathered, a small cautious relief

lines.text: They say the old goblin woman died on the bridge. Road's open. Doesn't feel like winning.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.text: Goblins on the hill, grain going up the path. Odd neighbours. Better than dead ones.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.text: They found something under the river, they say. The field by the docks froze the same night.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.text: Mayor knew the ground was cooling. Six years he knew. I'd have planted differently.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmer
lines.direction: plain, weathered and quietly worried

lines.text: Another sack carried uphill. Same empty bowl down here.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: If talk were kindling, the Ash Market would heat the Vale.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: They pay by the day. Funny how the days keep getting longer.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: The watch says the goblins scattered when their old woman fell. Scattered where, in this cold?
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: Carried my first sack up the goblin path today. The little ones watched me the whole way.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: Ground under the docks went cold as a grave. Nobody's saying why.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: Hands are cold, but they still work. That's something.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
lines.direction: young, tired, dry working voice

lines.text: River steams, nets come up cold. Tell me how that works.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: Do not whistle over the water. Let it keep its own counsel.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: Used to take two hands to lift this net. Now one will do.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: Things went downstream after the fight. The river's carried worse. Not much worse.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: Goblin children fish the far bank now. Taught one to tie a net. Don't tell the captain.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: River's stopped steaming at the docks. First time since I was a boy. Feels like a held breath.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: Two guards on the third pier all night, watching the water. Never seen the river so well minded.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_fisher
lines.direction: low, unhurried, superstitious river voice

lines.text: Road is shut, cart is empty. That is the price of it.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Coin is welcome. A clear road would be better.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Look all you like. I remember when people bought things too.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Blood on the planks and carts going over them. Trade's never been squeamish.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: The clan wants salt, of all things. I never thought I'd have goblin custom.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: People are buying blankets. Only blankets. Somebody knows something about this cold.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Prices are what they are. Don't blame the merchant for the weather.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Everything here is honest goods. Mostly honest. Ask me about the wool.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Shards for a copper. A copper! Ash Market's practically giving them away. Makes me nervous.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
lines.direction: brisk market patter with worry beneath it

lines.text: Captain says hold here. So here is where I hold.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Keep a light by your door tonight. Just in case.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Bridge watch was a good posting once.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: We took the bridge back. The captain hasn't said a word since. Neither have I.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Captain made peace with them. Some of the lads don't like it. I like breathing.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Orders are to watch the docks now. Watch them for what, nobody says.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Long shift, cold boots. Same as every week.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Pier duty. Stand by the river, don't touch the glow. Coldest posting in the Vale.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_guard
lines.direction: restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice

lines.text: Hot bowls to the left. Wet boots stay by the door.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: Bree keeps the fire going. We keep everyone fed.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: An empty cup is easy fixed. The rest takes listening.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: Bree poured one for the goblin grandmother tonight. Nobody asked why. Nobody drank it.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: We send stew up the hill now. Bree says hungry is hungry, whatever its ears look like.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: Bree's hearth is the warmest room in town again. Funny how that's starting to matter.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: Folk keep coming in to shout about the mayor. Then they stay for the soup.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: Every hearth in town has a new shard. Bree won't buy one. Says she's forgotten enough.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
lines.direction: practical, warm, quick but clear

lines.text: Bet you cannot jump that puddle with all that armour.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_child
lines.direction: bright, pitched up, innocent without baby talk

lines.text: We are playing bridge guards. Nobody wants to be the bridge.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_child
lines.direction: bright, pitched up, innocent without baby talk

lines.text: Have you seen a frog today? A proper big one?
lines.speaker: townsfolk_child
lines.direction: bright, pitched up, innocent without baby talk

lines.text: Dad says the goblins aren't coming back. He didn't look happy about it.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_child
lines.direction: bright, pitched up, innocent without baby talk

lines.text: There's a goblin girl who can spit further than me. I'm going to beat her.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_child
lines.direction: bright, pitched up, innocent without baby talk

lines.text: Pip says the river had a heart and somebody took it out. Is that true?
lines.speaker: townsfolk_child
lines.direction: bright, pitched up, innocent without baby talk

lines.text: Hands where I can see them. Food where I can smell it.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_archer
lines.direction: thin, wary rasp, short measured phrases

lines.text: Your river? Funny. It runs past our camp too.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_archer
lines.direction: thin, wary rasp, short measured phrases

lines.text: Bowstring hates this damp. So do I.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_archer
lines.direction: thin, wary rasp, short measured phrases

lines.text: Fine boots. Must be warm having two good ones.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_cutthroat
lines.direction: sly, scratchy goblin voice, dry amusement

lines.text: Town locks its grain. Calls us thieves. Clever town.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_cutthroat
lines.direction: sly, scratchy goblin voice, dry amusement

lines.text: Easy now. I am only looking. You do that too.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_cutthroat
lines.direction: sly, scratchy goblin voice, dry amusement

lines.text: Stay your side. I will stay mine.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_spear
lines.direction: rough, hungry goblin rasp, guarded not monstrous

lines.text: Spear is light. Empty belly is heavy.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_spear
lines.direction: rough, hungry goblin rasp, guarded not monstrous

lines.text: Mother says watch the ford. I watch the ford.
lines.speaker: townsfolk_goblin_spear
lines.direction: rough, hungry goblin rasp, guarded not monstrous
